column2: A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a small welding shop's contact page. The page is a photoreal shop work-order ticket lying on a brushed-steel workbench under a cool work light: a heavy light-grey card with a black hazard stripe, the attached chrome emblem (gear ring, welder, TRUST WELDING, EST 2025) printed at the top, the heading "Tell me about the job", four form fields (Name, Phone, What do you need built or fixed?, Where is it?) drawn as ruled boxes, a solid teal-blue button "Send the request", and three small buttons "Text 425-283-6496", "Call", "Instagram". A dark site header above with the emblem and the phone number. Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no wood.

A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a welding shop's contact page: the form sits on a black powder-coated steel plate bolted with four hex bolts to a dark concrete wall, lit by one hanging shop light. The attached chrome emblem is mounted on the plate at the top. White heading "Tell me about the job", four form fields as recessed steel slots (Name, Phone, What do you need built or fixed?, Where is it?), a teal-blue button "Send the request", and three ways in as metal tags: "Text 425-283-6496", "Call", "Instagram". Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no wood, no pastels.

A full-page website design, desktop 1440 wide, for a welding shop's contact page where the biggest element is a photo drop zone: a large dark steel frame with a dashed teal-blue outline and the words "Drop a photo of the job", beside three short fields (Name, Phone, Where is it?) and a teal-blue button "Send the request". The attached chrome emblem sits in the dark header with the number 425-283-6496. Background: a dark welding shop, out of focus, a hint of a workbench. Heading "Tell me about the job". Masculine, industrial, crisp, legible, no rust, no pastels.
